@@ -297,6 +297,38 @@ class PaginationTests(SimpleTestCase):
         with self.assertRaises(EmptyPage):
             paginator.get_page(1)
 
+    def test_paginator_iter(self):
+        """
+        Iterating over a Paginator yields Page objects for each page.
+        """
+        ten = list(range(10))
+        paginator = Paginator(ten, 3)
+        pages = list(paginator)
+        self.assertEqual(len(pages), 4)
+        # Check that iterating yields the same pages as calling .page() manually.
+        for i, page in enumerate(pages):
+            expected_page = paginator.page(i + 1)
+            self.assertEqual(page.number, expected_page.number)
+            self.assertEqual(list(page.object_list), list(expected_page.object_list))
+
+    def test_paginator_iter_empty(self):
+        """
+        Iterating over a Paginator with an empty object_list yields one page.
+        """
+        paginator = Paginator([], 2)
+        pages = list(paginator)
+        self.assertEqual(len(pages), 1)
+        self.assertEqual(pages[0].number, 1)
+
+    def test_paginator_iter_no_empty_first_page(self):
+        """
+        Iterating over a Paginator with allow_empty_first_page=False and empty
+        object_list yields no pages.
+        """
+        paginator = Paginator([], 2, allow_empty_first_page=False)
+        pages = list(paginator)
+        self.assertEqual(len(pages), 0)
+
